preconditions.description: The number of rows M must be between 1 and 2 inclusive.
The number of columns N must be between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The upper bound K for the random integers must be between 1 and 100,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must be a single integer between 0 and 998,244,352 inclusive, representing P * Q^(-1) modulo 998,244,353.
